title: Knight on the Rim
setup: Black's knight has wandered to h5, a square with only four exits, and none of them look friendly.
hint: Every square that knight can reach is already covered or occupied. All it needs now is a shove.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{g4}} attacks the knight and h5 is a dead end: f6 is met by exf6, f4 by Bxf4, g3 by hxg3, and g7 is Black's own pawn. A knight at the edge of the board has four squares at most. Cover them and it has nowhere to run.
